programs.name: Kleiner Perkins Fellows
programs.window: Opens early autumn for the following summer
programs.note: The single best-known product/design fellowship. Places students at KP portfolio companies for a paid summer, plus a mentorship programme.

programs.name: Contrary Fellowship
programs.note: Contrary also runs a Venture Partner programme for students who want to source deals on campus. Both are worth applying to.

programs.name: Dorm Room Fund
programs.window: Investment-team recruiting, typically autumn and spring
programs.note: Student-run VC fund. Being an investment partner is real VC experience.

programs.name: Z Fellows
programs.window: Rolling, cohorts several times a year
programs.note: One-week programme with a $10k investment. Very short application.

programs.name: Neo Scholars
programs.note: Selective cohort for technical students, with mentorship and funding.

programs.name: a16z Speedrun
programs.note: For students who want to start something rather than join a fund.

programs.name: Included VC
programs.note: Free, remote, aimed at people without a traditional route into VC.

programs.name: GoingVC
programs.note: Paid programme. Listed because its free job board and network are useful.

programs.name: Venture University
programs.note: Paid apprenticeship. Listed for awareness, not endorsement.
